intro: Facial rejuvenation is not one procedure but a plan. It addresses the things that make skin look tired: dullness, uneven tone, rough texture, open pores, fine lines and the early loss of firmness. Pune's sun, pollution and long commutes accelerate all of them, and most patients who visit Skin Essence for rejuvenation are in their thirties and forties and simply want to look well rested.

Dr. Daksha Patel, an MD dermatologist, starts with a skin analysis to see what is actually driving the tired look, because the fix for dullness caused by dead-skin build-up is different from the fix for pigmentation or early lines. The plan then combines medical skincare with in-clinic procedures such as chemical peels for texture, laser toning for tone and microneedling to rebuild collagen.

Where appropriate, injectables such as Botox or fillers are discussed separately and only when they will make a meaningful difference. The aim at our Kalyani Nagar clinic is a fresher version of your own face, with results that colleagues notice without being able to say why.
whoIsItFor: Skin that looks dull, tired or uneven despite a good routine
Rough texture, open pores or a build-up of dead skin from sun and pollution
Fine lines and early loss of firmness in the thirties and forties
Post-acne texture once breakouts are under control
A pre-event glow with 4 to 8 weeks in hand, for women and men

howItWorks.title: Skin analysis
howItWorks.description: We examine tone, texture, pore size, hydration and early lines under magnification, review your current products and photograph your skin as a baseline.

howItWorks.title: Foundation routine
howItWorks.description: A prescription routine with sunscreen, a retinoid or gentle acids and antioxidants is started so that in-clinic results last.

howItWorks.title: In-clinic course
howItWorks.description: A series of peels, laser toning or microneedling sessions, chosen for your concerns and spaced 3 to 4 weeks apart, brightens tone and smooths texture progressively.

howItWorks.title: Maintenance
howItWorks.description: A session every 2 to 3 months and the home routine keep the results, with the plan adjusted as your skin changes with the seasons.

sessionsAndDowntime.results: Glow after the first session; texture and tone improve over 2–3 months

aftercare: Use only the cleanser, moisturiser and sunscreen advised for a week after peels or microneedling.
Skip scrubs, retinoids and salon facials for 5 to 7 days after each session.
Sunscreen every morning is what protects the result you paid for.
Keep hydration, sleep and sun protection consistent between sessions.

faqs.a: It depends on your skin. Typically a home routine plus a course of peels, laser toning or microneedling. Injectables are discussed separately when lines or volume loss are the main concern.

faqs.q: Is this the same as a salon facial?
faqs.a: No. Salon facials clean and hydrate the surface for a day or two. Dermatologist-led rejuvenation uses medical-grade peels, lasers and microneedling that change the skin over months, with settings chosen for Indian skin.

faqs.q: When should I start before an event?
faqs.a: Ideally 2 to 3 months before, so the course can finish and any reaction can settle. A single glow session 7 to 10 days before an event works if you have had that treatment before.
Yes. Many of our male patients in Pune come for dullness, open pores and post-acne texture. The plan is the same, adjusted for thicker skin and shaving.

faqs.q: Will I look like I have had work done?
faqs.a: No. The procedures improve skin quality rather than changing features. Any injectables are dosed conservatively so your expressions stay natural.
